claims.text: From the .pptx, slide 2's notes appeared under ### Notes: with all three paragraphs; indented bullets became plain lines
Slides with no notes or notes of spaces only got no notes section
Slides-only PDF: no notes, no slide markers, titles as plain lines, one split
Notes-pages PDF: notes present, unlabeled, one sentence split, stray page numbers
PowerPoint print layout defaults to Full Page Slides; Notes Pages is the only layout with notes
Reviewed copy put the caveat and start date on slide 2

not_claimed: PowerPoint's own Save as PDF behavior
how a model weighs notes against slide text
